resources.string: Performs selected system gesture actions, including opening the notification shade and locking the screen. It does not read screen content.

To use system actions assigned to desktop gestures, enable “e_e launcher — system gestures” once under Accessibility. The service does not read screen content and is used only for the selected system actions.

The initial speed stays constant until the last icon leaves the folder. After that, retention controls one shared slowdown for the whole chain: 100% keeps its speed unchanged, while 0% slows it quickly almost to a stop. Fixed spacing keeps icons in order on the path.
Pages can be swiped manually in reorder mode. Hold an icon over another cell to update the order before releasing it.
